mapper.select: SELECT emp26_init_leave_id AS init_leave_id , emp01_person_id AS person_id , emp26_year AS year , emp01_emp_no AS person_no , f_emp_kor_nm(emp26_person_id) AS person_name , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd, emp26_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS pos_name , emp26_use_days AS use_days FROM emp26_init_leave INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp26_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp26_person_id = emp02_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp26_person_id = emp03_person_id WHERE emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate() ) AND emp26_init_leave_id = #{initLeaveId} AND emp26_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp26_init_leave ( emp26_init_leave_id, emp26_company_id, emp26_person_id, emp26_year, emp26_use_days ) VALUES ( #{initLeaveId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{year}, #{useDays} )
